web_fixture.snippet: Reference for the monitoring API, including the default per-tenant request rate limit of the polling endpoint.
web_fixture.content:
# API reference

Kelterby Switchgear docs, revised 2026-06-02.

The monitoring API exposes live load and trip events for every connected relay panel. Clients poll the polling endpoint for incremental updates; the endpoint applies a per-tenant request rate limit and an automatic backoff window.

The default rate limit and backoff behaviour for the polling endpoint are listed under "Polling limits" in this reference.

web_fixture.content:
# Quickstart

Kelterby Switchgear docs, updated 2026-04-18.

Create an API key in the console, point your client at the monitoring endpoint, and subscribe to the panels you want to watch. The first events usually arrive within a minute.

Rate limits and retry defaults are documented in the API reference under "Polling limits".
